title: RNS_Epilepsy-iBIDS
description: A long-term intracranial EEG (iEEG) dataset from 8 epilepsy patients implanted with a responsive neurostimulation (RNS) system, recorded from bilateral epileptic lesion areas. Each recording contains 90 seconds of dual-channel iEEG around each stimulation, with stimulation markers and clinician-set stimulation parameters provided. The dataset supports study of changes in seizure onset patterns over the course of epilepsy and of iEEG changes following electrical stimulation.
methods_description: Dual-channel iEEG was recorded with RNS devices around each stimulation event (60 s before stimulation onset and about 30 s after its end). Data were stored in EDF format and organized in BIDS, with one week of recordings per session covering days with frequent seizure onsets. Patients were included if seizures were intracranially recorded for more than six months. Stimulation parameters set at clinical follow-ups are stored in the ieeg.json files. Technical validation used power spectral analysis, envelope length, and phase locking value.
